description: This PHP class 'UrlLang' is part of the Goteo project and is responsible for managing URL language configurations, host modifications for localization, and session management skipping based on request paths. It makes use of external components like Symfony's Request, and project-specific Config and Lang classes.

classes.name: UrlLang
classes.description: A utility class for managing URL language settings, host management, and session control within the Goteo project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UrlLang object with a Request, setting the request object, current path, and host.

methods.name: skipSessionManagement
methods.description: Determines if session management should be skipped based on URL path and configuration.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns a modified host URL based on language and configuration settings.

methods.name: matchPrefix
methods.description: Checks if the beginning of a string matches any of the provided prefixes.
